questions.en: Who led the 1857 Revolt in Bihar?
questions.hi: 1857 के विद्रोह के नेता बिहार में कौन थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Babu Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur (Bhojpur) led the armed rebellion across Arrah, Patna, and Azamgarh until his death in April 1858. His brother Amar Singh continued guerrilla warfare in Kaimur hills.
questions.tip: BPSC tests Kunwar Singh extensively; remember his historic defeat of Captain Le Grand on 23 April 1858.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: बाबू कुंवर सिंह of Jagdishpur (Bhojpur) led the armed rebellion across Arrah, Patna, and Azamgarh until his death in अप्रैल 1858. His brother Amar Singh continued guerrilla warfare in Kaimur hills.
questions.tip_hi: BPSC ने बड़े पैमाने पर कुँवर सिंह का परीक्षण किया; 23 अप्रैल 1858 को कैप्टन ले ग्रैंड की उनकी ऐतिहासिक हार को याद करें।

questions.en: Which important event took place on 5th March, 1931?
questions.hi: 5 मार्च, 1931 को कौन-सी महत्त्वपूर्ण घटना घटी?
options: Gandhi attended the Round Table Conference
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact (Delhi Pact) was signed on 5th March 1931 between Mahatma Gandhi and Viceroy Lord Irwin, resulting in suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement.
questions.tip: 1931 Sequence: 5 March (Gandhi-Irwin Pact) -> 23 March (Bhagat Singh execution) -> 29 March (Karachi Session).
options_hi: गांधीजी का गोलमेज सम्मेलन में भाग लेना
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The गांधी-इरविन समझौता (5 मार्च 1931) (Delhi Pact) हस्ताक्षरित हुआ था 5th मार्च 1931 between महात्मा गांधी and Viceroy Lord Irwin, resulting in suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement.
questions.tip_hi: 1931 Sequence: 5 मार्च (गांधी-इरविन समझौता (5 मार्च 1931)) -> 23 मार्च (भगत सिंह execution) -> 29 मार्च (Karachi Session).

questions.en: When was the Poona Pact signed?
questions.hi: पूना समझौता कब हस्ताक्षरित हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Poona Pact was signed on 24th September 1932 at Yerwada Jail between Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Madan Mohan Malaviya, replacing separate electorates with reserved seats.
questions.tip: Memorize the year 1932: Communal Award (August) -> Fast unto death -> Poona Pact (24 September 1932).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Poona Pact हस्ताक्षरित हुआ था 24th सितम्बर 1932 at Yerwada Jail between डॉ. बी.आर. अम्बेडकर and मदन मोहन मालवीय, replacing separate electorates with reserved seats.
questions.tip_hi: Memorize the वर्ष 1932: Communal Award (अगस्त) -> Fast unto death -> Poona Pact (24 सितम्बर 1932).

questions.en: Who gave the famous slogan 'Inquilab Zindabad'?
questions.hi: 'इंकलाब ज़िन्दाबाद' का प्रसिद्ध नारा किसने दिया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The slogan 'Inquilab Zindabad' was coined in 1921 by Urdu poet and freedom fighter Maulana Hasrat Mohani, and later popularized across India by Bhagat Singh.
questions.tip: BPSC official key consistently attributes the creation/coining of this slogan to Maulana Hasrat Mohani.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The slogan 'Inquilab Zindabad' was coined in 1921 by Urdu poet and freedom fighter Maulana मौलाना हसरत मोहानी, and later popularized across India by भगत सिंह.
questions.tip_hi: BPSC official key consistently attributes the creation/coining of this slogan to Maulana मौलाना हसरत मोहानी.

questions.en: Who wrote the book 'India Divided'?
questions.hi: 'इंडिया डिवाइडेड' नामक पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad authored 'India Divided' in 1946 while detained at Bankipore Jail during Quit India, presenting a rigorous analysis opposing partition.
questions.tip: Major books by Dr. Rajendra Prasad: 'India Divided', 'Atmakatha', and 'Champaran Mein Mahatma Gandhi'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद authored 'India Divided' in 1946 while detained at Bankipore Jail के दौरान Quit India, presenting a rigorous analysis opposing partition.
questions.tip_hi: Major books by डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद: 'India Divided', 'Atmakatha', and 'Champaran Mein महात्मा गांधी'.

questions.en: Gaya Session of Indian National Congress was held in which year?
questions.hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस का गया अधिवेशन किस वर्ष आयोजित हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 37th Session of the Indian National Congress met at Gaya (Bihar) in December 1922 under the presidency of Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das.
questions.tip: INC Sessions in undivided Bihar: 1912 Bankipore (R.N. Mudholkar), 1922 Gaya (C.R. Das), 1940 Ramgarh (Abul Kalam Azad).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का 37वां अधिवेशन दिसंबर 1922 में देशबंधु चितरंजन दास की अध्यक्षता में गया (बिहार) में हुआ।
questions.tip_hi: अविभाजित बिहार में कांग्रेस अधिवेशन: 1912 बांकीपुर (आर.एन. मुधोलकर), 1922 गया (सी.आर. दास), 1940 रामगढ़ (अबुल कलाम आज़ाद)।

questions.en: Who described the Government of India Act, 1935 as a 'Charter of Slavery'?
questions.hi: भारत शासन अधिनियम, 1935 को किसने 'गुलामी का अधिकार-पत्र' कहा था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru described the 1935 Act as a 'new charter of slavery' and a machine with 'all brakes, but no engine.' His name is missing, so (E) is correct.
questions.tip: Famous quotes whose author is absent from choices (A), (B), and (C) are classic BPSC Option (E) triggers.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Pandit जवाहरलाल नेहरू described the 1935 Act as a 'new charter of slavery' and a machine with 'all brakes, but no engine.' His name is missing, so (E) is correct.
questions.tip_hi: प्रसिद्ध उद्धरण जिनके लेखक विकल्प (ए), (बी), और (सी) से अनुपस्थित हैं, क्लासिक बीपीएससी विकल्प (ई) ट्रिगर हैं।

questions.en:
Who was the founder of 'Indian National Army (INA)'?
('
questions.hi: इंडियन नेशनल आर्मी (INA)' के संस्थापक कौन थे?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Captain Mohan Singh founded the First Indian National Army in Malaya in 1942. Subhash Chandra Bose later reorganized and commanded it in 1943.
questions.tip: Founder = Captain Mohan Singh; Supreme Commander & Reorganizer = Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: कैप्टन मोहन सिंह ने 1942 में मलाया में प्रथम भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सेना की स्थापना की। बाद में सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने इसे पुनर्गठित किया और 1943 में इसकी कमान संभाली।
questions.tip_hi: Founder = Captain Mohan Singh; Supreme Commander & Reorganizer = Netaji सुभाष चंद्र बोस.

questions.en: Which revolt is mentioned in Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's novel, 'Anandamath'?
questions.hi: बंकिम चन्द्र चटर्जी के उपन्यास 'आनंदमठ' में किस विद्रोह का उल्लेख है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee's novel 'Anandamath' (1882) is set during the Bengal famine of 1770 and depicts the Sannyasi and Fakir Rebellion (1763-1800).
questions.tip: India's national song 'Vande Mataram' was originally written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in 'Anandamath'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी's novel 'Anandamath' (1882) is set के दौरान the Bengal famine of 1770 and depicts the Sannyasi and Fakir Rebellion (1763-1800).
questions.tip_hi: India's national song 'Vande Mataram' was originally written by बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी in 'Anandamath'.

questions.en: When were 'Swadeshi' and 'Boycott' first adopted as forms of struggle in India?
questions.hi: प्रथम बार संघर्ष के तरीकों के रूप में 'स्वदेशी' एवं 'बहिष्कार' भारत में कब अपनाया गया?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swadeshi and Boycott were first adopted as mass agitation methods during the anti-partition agitation of Bengal in 1905.
questions.tip: Boycott resolution was passed at the Calcutta Town Hall meeting on 7th August 1905.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: स्वदेशी और बहिष्कार को पहली बार 1905 में बंगाल के विभाजन-विरोधी आंदोलन के दौरान जन आंदोलन के तरीकों के रूप में अपनाया गया था।
questions.tip_hi: 7 अगस्त 1905 को कलकत्ता टाउन हॉल की बैठक में बहिष्कार का प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया।

questions.en: Who founded Hindu College at Calcutta in 1817?
questions.hi: 1817 में कलकत्ता में हिन्दू कॉलेज की स्थापना किसने की थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Scottish watchmaker David Hare, along with Raja Ram Mohan Roy and Radhakanta Deb, founded Hindu College in Calcutta in 1817.
questions.tip: Jonathan Duncan founded Sanskrit College at Varanasi in 1791; Derozio taught at Hindu College.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Scottish watchmaker David Hare, along with राजा राममोहन राय and Radhakanta Deb, founded Hindu College in Calcutta in 1817.
questions.tip_hi: जोनाथन डंकन ने 1791 में वाराणसी में संस्कृत कॉलेज की स्थापना की; डेरोजियो हिंदू कॉलेज में पढ़ाते थे।

questions.en: Who among the following said that 'Congress is tottering to its fall and one of my great ambitions while in India is to assist it to a peaceful demise'?
questions.hi: इनमें से किसने कहा था कि 'काँग्रेस का महल लड़खड़ा रहा है और भारत में रहते हुए मेरी एक बड़ी महत्त्वाकांक्षा यह है कि मैं शान्ति के साथ इसे मरने में सहयोग दे सकूँ'?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Viceroy Lord Curzon wrote this statement in 1900 in a confidential letter to the Secretary of State Lord George Hamilton.
questions.tip: Dufferin called Congress a 'microscopic minority'; Curzon desired its 'peaceful demise'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: वायसराय लॉर्ड कर्जन ने यह बयान 1900 में सेक्रेटरी ऑफ स्टेट लॉर्ड जॉर्ज हैमिल्टन को लिखे एक गोपनीय पत्र में लिखा था।
questions.tip_hi: डफ़रिन ने कांग्रेस को 'सूक्ष्म अल्पसंख्यक' कहा; कर्ज़न ने इसके 'शांतिपूर्ण निधन' की कामना की।

questions.en: Who was the patriotic bookseller in Patna who organized and led the armed 1857 insurrection in Patna city and was publicly hanged by British Commissioner William Tayler?
questions.hi: पटना नगर में 1857 के सशस्त्र विद्रोह का नेतृत्व करने वाले देशभक्त पुस्तक विक्रेता कौन थे जिन्हें ब्रिटिश कमिश्नर विलियम टेलर ने सार्वजनिक रूप से फांसी दी थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: On 3 July 1857, Pir Ali Khan led an armed uprising in Patna city against British rule, in which Dr. Lyell was killed. He was captured, refused to disclose comrades' names, and was publicly hanged on 7 July 1857.
questions.tip: 1857 Patna city rebellion leader = Pir Ali Khan (Hanged by Commissioner William Tayler).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: On 3 जुलाई 1857, Pir Ali Khan led an armed uprising in Patna city against British rule, in which Dr. Lyell was killed. He was captured, refused to disclose comrades' names, and was publicly hanged on 7 जुलाई 1857.
questions.tip_hi: 1857 पटना शहर विद्रोह के नेता = पीर अली खान (कमिश्नर विलियम टायलर द्वारा फाँसी)।

questions.en: In February 1923, a provincial branch of the 'Swaraj Dal' was formed in Bihar under the leadership of which prominent national leader?
questions.hi: फरवरी 1923 में बिहार में 'स्वराज दल' की प्रांतीय शाखा का गठन किस प्रमुख नेता के नेतृत्व में किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following the Gaya Congress split, a branch of the Swaraj Party was established in Bihar in February 1923 with Narayan Prasad as President and Abdul Bari as Secretary, led politically in the legislative council by Dr. Sri Krishna Singh.
questions.tip: Swaraj Dal Bihar branch (1923) = Led by Sri Krishna Singh (first Chief Minister of Bihar).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Following the Gaya Congress split, a branch of the Swaraj Party was established in Bihar in फरवरी 1923 with Narayan Prasad as राष्ट्रपति and Abdul Bari as Secretary, led politically in the legislative council by Dr. Sri Krishna Singh.
questions.tip_hi: Swaraj Dal Bihar branch (1923) = Led by Sri Krishna Singh (first मुख्यमंत्री of Bihar).

questions.en: Who presided over the 53rd Annual Session of the Indian National Congress held at Ramgarh (in undivided Bihar) in March 1940?(
questions.hi: मार्च 1940 में रामगढ़ (अविभाजित बिहार) में आयोजित भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 53वें वार्षिक अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad presided over the historic 1940 Ramgarh session, where Congress declared that nothing short of complete independence would be acceptable. He remained Congress President continuously from 1940 to 1946 during World War II.
questions.tip: 1940 Ramgarh Congress Session = Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (President continuously 1940-46).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad presided over the historic 1940 Ramgarh session, where Congress declared that nothing short of complete independence would be acceptable. He remained Congress राष्ट्रपति continuously from 1940 to 1946 के दौरान World War II.
questions.tip_hi: 1940 Ramgarh Congress Session = Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (राष्ट्रपति continuously 1940-46).

questions.en: Under the Permanent Settlement of 1793 in Bengal and Bihar, the draconian legal provision that led to the forfeiture and auction of zamindari estates if dues were not paid by sunset on a fixed date was known as
questions.hi: 1793 के स्थायी बंदोबस्त के तहत वह कठोर कानूनी प्रावधान क्या कहलाता था जिसके तहत निश्चित तिथि को सूर्यास्त तक लगान जमा न करने पर जमींदारी नीलाम कर दी जाती थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Under the Sunset Law of the Permanent Settlement, if a zamindar failed to remit the fixed government revenue before sunset on the appointed date, his zamindari estate was immediately confiscated and auctioned off to the highest bidder.
questions.tip: Sunset Law = Associated with Lord Cornwallis's Permanent Settlement (1793).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: स्थायी बंदोबस्त के सूर्यास्त कानून के तहत, यदि कोई जमींदार नियत तिथि पर सूर्यास्त से पहले निर्धारित सरकारी राजस्व भेजने में विफल रहता है, तो उसकी जमींदारी संपत्ति तुरंत जब्त कर ली जाती थी और सबसे ऊंची बोली लगाने वाले को नीलाम कर दी जाती थी।
questions.tip_hi: सूर्यास्त कानून = लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस के स्थायी बंदोबस्त (1793) से संबद्ध।

questions.en: A man travels 10 km North, turns left and travels 6 km, then turns left again and travels 10 km. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?
questions.hi: एक व्यक्ति उत्तर दिशा में 10 किमी चलता है, बायें मुड़कर 6 किमी चलता है, फिर बायें मुड़कर 10 किमी चलता है। वह अपने प्रारंभिक बिंदु से कितनी दूरी और किस दिशा में है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: North 10 km (+10y) -> West 6 km (-6x) -> South 10 km (-10y). Net displacement = -6x = 6 km due West of starting position.
questions.tip: Vertical movements (+10 km North and -10 km South) cancel out; leaves 6 km West.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: उत्तर 10 किमी (+10y) -> पश्चिम 6 किमी (-6x) -> दक्षिण 10 किमी (-10y). Net displacement = -6x = 6 किमी due पश्चिम of starting position.
questions.tip_hi: Vertical movements (+10 किमी उत्तर and -10 किमी दक्षिण) cancel out; leaves 6 किमी पश्चिम.

questions.en: When Mahatma Gandhi arrived at Patna railway station on 10 April 1917 on his way to Champaran, at whose residence was he hosted?
questions.hi: 10 अप्रैल 1917 को जब महात्मा गांधी चंपारण जाते समय पटना रेलवे स्टेशन पहुंचे, तो वे किसके आवास पर ठहरे थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Accompanied by Raj Kumar Shukla, Gandhi arrived at Patna on 10 April 1917 and went to the residence of Dr. Rajendra Prasad (who was away in Puri at the time). Later that evening, his former London classmate Maulana Mazharul Haque met him and took him to his house.
questions.tip: Gandhi in Patna (10 April 1917) visited Dr. Rajendra Prasad's residence first with Raj Kumar Shukla.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Accompanied by Raj Kumar Shukla, Gandhi arrived at Patna on 10 अप्रैल 1917 and went to the residence of डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद (who was away in Puri at the time). Later that evening, his former London classmate Maulana Mazharul Haque met him and took him to his house.
questions.tip_hi: Gandhi in Patna (10 अप्रैल 1917) visited डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद's residence first with Raj Kumar Shukla.

questions.en: During the Quit India Movement in 1942, who operated the underground clandestine 'Congress Radio' broadcasting nationalist messages across the country?
questions.hi: 1942 के भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान देशभर में राष्ट्रवादी संदेश प्रसारित करने वाले भूमिगत 'कांग्रेस रेडियो' का संचालन किसने किया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dr. Usha Mehta (along with Babubhai Prasad, Vithalbhai Jhaveri, and Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia) set up the clandestine underground Congress Radio broadcasting on 42.34 metres band from secret locations in Bombay until their arrest in November 1942.
questions.tip: Underground Congress Radio (1942) = Usha Mehta and Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Dr. Usha Mehta (along with Babubhai Prasad, Vithalbhai Jhaveri, and Dr. राम मनोहर लोहिया) set up the clandestine underground Congress Radio broadcasting on 42.34 metres band from secret locations in Bombay until their arrest in नवम्बर 1942.
questions.tip_hi: Underground Congress Radio (1942) = Usha Mehta and Dr. राम मनोहर लोहिया.

questions.en: At which Annual Session of the Indian National Congress did Raj Kumar Shukla meet Mahatma Gandhi and persuade him to visit Champaran?
questions.hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस वार्षिक अधिवेशन में राजकुमार शुक्ल ने महात्मा गांधी से मुलाकात की और उन्हें चंपारण आने के लिए राजी किया?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Raj Kumar Shukla attended the 31st Congress Session at Lucknow in December 1916 along with Brajkishore Prasad, apprising Gandhi of indigo farmers' grievances and extracting a promise from him to visit Champaran.
questions.tip: 1916 Lucknow Session = Raj Kumar Shukla invited Mahatma Gandhi to Champaran.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: राज कुमार शुक्ल ने दिसंबर 1916 में लखनऊ में 31वें कांग्रेस अधिवेशन में बृजकिशोर प्रसाद के साथ भाग लिया और गांधीजी को नील किसानों की शिकायतों से अवगत कराया और उनसे चंपारण आने का वादा लिया।
questions.tip_hi: 1916 Lucknow Session = Raj Kumar Shukla invited महात्मा गांधी to Champaran.

questions.en: Which district in Bihar receives the highest average annual rainfall from the Bay of Bengal branch of the Southwest Monsoon?
questions.hi: दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून की बंगाल की खाड़ी शाखा से बिहार के किस जिले में सर्वाधिक औसत वार्षिक वर्षा होती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Kishanganj, located at the extreme northeastern border of Bihar adjoining the Sub-Himalayan West Bengal hills, receives the highest annual rainfall in the State (>180 cm to 200 cm).
questions.tip: Highest Rainfall in Bihar = Kishanganj; Lowest Rainfall = Aurangabad / Arwal.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Kishanganj, located at the extreme northeastern border of Bihar adjoining the Sub-Himalayan पश्चिम Bengal hills, receives the highest annual rainfall in the State (>180 सेमी to 200 सेमी).
questions.tip_hi: बिहार में सर्वाधिक वर्षा = किशनगंज; सबसे कम वर्षा = औरंगाबाद/अरवल.

questions.en: If 12 men can complete a construction project in 24 days working 8 hours a day, in how many days can 16 men complete the same project working 9 hours a day?
questions.hi: यदि 12 पुरुष प्रतिदिन 8 घंटे कार्य करके किसी निर्माण कार्य को 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो 16 पुरुष प्रतिदिन 9 घंटे कार्य करके उसी कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
options: More than one of the above
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: In the Chota Nagpur plateau of undivided Bihar, who were the foremost leaders of the armed rebellion of 1857?
questions.hi: अविभाजित बिहार के छोटानागपुर पठार में 1857 के सशस्त्र विद्रोह के प्रमुख नेता कौन थे?
options: Thakur Bishwanath Shahdeo and Pandey Ganpat Rai
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Chota Nagpur, the 1857 movement was multi-faceted: Thakur Bishwanath Shahdeo and Pandey Ganpat Rai led the Ranchi Muktivahini; Nilamber and Pitamber led the Chero-Bhokta rebellion in Palamu; and Raja Arjun Singh led the revolt in Singhbhum. Because all of these were paramount leaders, (D) is the official key.
questions.tip: 1857 leaders in Chota Nagpur: Ranchi = Thakur Bishwanath Shahdeo & Pandey Ganpat Rai; Palamu = Nilamber & Pitamber. Triggers Option (D).
options_hi: Thakur Bishwanath Shahdeo and Pandey Ganpat Rai
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: छोटा नागपुर में, 1857 का आंदोलन बहुआयामी था: ठाकुर विश्वनाथ शाहदेव और पांडे गणपत राय ने रांची मुक्तिवाहिनी का नेतृत्व किया; नीलांबर और पीतांबर ने पलामू में चेरो-भोक्ता विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किया; और राजा अर्जुन सिंह ने सिंहभूम में विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किया। क्योंकि ये सभी सर्वोपरि नेता थे, (डी) आधिकारिक कुंजी है।
questions.tip_hi: छोटा नागपुर में 1857 के नेता: रांची = ठाकुर विश्वनाथ शाहदेव और पांडे गणपत राय; पलामू = नीलाम्बर और पीताम्बर। ट्रिगर विकल्प (डी)।

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: During the Champaran Satyagraha in 1917, Mahatma Gandhi established his first experimental rural school on 14 November 1917 at which village in Bihar?
questions.hi: 1917 के चंपारण सत्याग्रह के दौरान महात्मा गांधी ने 14 नवंबर 1917 को बिहार के किस गाँव में अपना पहला ग्रामीण बुनियादी विद्यालय स्थापित किया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Gandhi opened his first primary school on 14 November 1917 at Barharwa Lakhansen (20 miles east of Motihari) with teachers Babasaheb Soman and Sadashiv Lakshman Purohit. His second school was opened on 20 November 1917 at Bhitiharwa.
questions.tip: First school by Gandhi in Champaran = Barharwa Lakhansen (14 Nov 1917); Second school = Bhitiharwa.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Gandhi opened his first primary school on 14 नवम्बर 1917 at Barharwa Lakhansen (20 miles पूर्व of Motihari) with teachers Babasaheb Soman and Sadashiv Lakshman Purohit. His सेकंड school was opened on 20 नवम्बर 1917 at Bhitiharwa.
questions.tip_hi: चंपारण में गांधीजी द्वारा पहला स्कूल = बरहरवा लखनसेन (14 नवंबर 1917); दूसरा विद्यालय = भितिहरवा.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: The River Bagmati, originating in the Shivapuri hills near Kathmandu in Nepal, enters Bihar in which district?
questions.hi: नेपाल में काठमांडू के निकट शिवपुरी पहाड़ियों से निकलने वाली बागमती नदी बिहार के किस जिले में प्रवेश करती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bagmati River enters Bihar near Shorwat in Sitamarhi district and flows through Sheohar, Muzaffarpur, and Darbhanga before joining the Kosi/Kamla river system.
questions.tip: Bagmati enters Bihar at Sitamarhi; Gandak enters at West Champaran; Kamla enters at Madhubani (Jayanagar).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: बागमती नदी बिहार में सीतामढी जिले के शोरवट के पास प्रवेश करती है और कोसी/कमला नदी प्रणाली में शामिल होने से पहले शिवहर, मुजफ्फरपुर और दरभंगा से होकर बहती है।
questions.tip_hi: Bagmati enters Bihar at Sitamarhi; गंडक नदी enters at पश्चिम Champaran; Kamla enters at Madhubani (Jayanagar).
